name: print-social-poster-collage-creativity-black-yellow-spray
title: Black and yellow creativity poster with collage portrait and spray texture
whatItIs: A black-bordered poster with a cream interior, featuring a surreal collaged portrait (planet and fabric replacing the head) over airbrushed color-block shapes and a bold serif 'Unleash your Creativity' headline.
whatItMeans: Replacing a normal portrait's head with an abstract collaged element visually embodies 'unleashed creativity' more directly than any literal illustration of the concept could.
techniques: collage unexpected elements (a planet, fabric) directly onto a photographic figure for surrealism
apply soft airbrush/spray texture behind color-block shapes for an artistic, unfinished edge
frame the whole poster in a solid black border to give it a gallery-print quality

vocabulary.definition: a composite image created by combining multiple photographs or photo elements into one surreal or symbolic scene
